edges.reason: gType is read when reporting the winner to the stats aggregator.
fee is used to compute the winner commission.
fee is multiplied in the referral amount calculation.
game index is used to store the ticket and player.
game index is used to resolve the jackpot and player list.
ticketPrice is enforced against msg.value.
ticketPrice multiplied by fee in calculateReferral.
newPrice is applied when the new game starts.
allTimeJackpot is accumulated after payouts.
allTimePlayers is accumulated after payouts.
paidToPartners is reset only after external transfers complete.
paidToPartners is incremented after the partner transfer.
isActive is required before buying a ticket.
toogleActive reads and rewrites isActive.
startGame requires isActive and can flip it.
toogleActive flips toogleStatus.
startGame consumes the pending toogleStatus flag.
jackpot[game] += msg.value accumulates the pot.
jackpot[game] is read for distribution.
players[game] is appended with msg.sender.
players[game] is read to pick and pay the winner.
players[game].length gates referral payout timing.
ownable.allowed(msg.sender) enforces the onlyOwner gate.
stats.newWinner is invoked with game results.
referralInstance resolves and registers referrals.
referralInstance resolves the partner for payout.
referralInstance resolves the sales partner for payout.
referralInstance returns the partner percent.
referralInstance returns the sales partner percent.
fundsDistributor is the target of the distributor payout call.
msg.sender is pushed into players[game] as the new ticket holder.
msg.sender is validated against the owner allowlist.
block timestamp feeds the pseudo-random seed.
block.timestamp is passed as the random seed for winner selection.
Full jackpot is transferred to the sole player before final bookkeeping.
Winner payout occurs before paidToPartners is reset.
Low-level gas-limited call to fundsDistributor can re-enter.
Randomness derives from block.timestamp, difficulty, number and blockhash.

normalization_plan.reason: ownableContract is only used to construct the ownable instance in the constructor.
distributor is only assigned to fundsDistributor in the constructor.
statsA is only used to construct the stats instance in the constructor.
referralSystem is only used to construct the referral instance in the constructor.
playedGame only indexes players inside the getPlayersInGame view.
playedGame only indexes jackpot inside the getGameJackpot view.
price is written directly to newPrice by changeTicketPrice.
min is a bound of the randomNumber computation.
max is a bound of the randomNumber computation.
time feeds the weak randomness seed inside randomNumber.
difficulty feeds the weak randomness seed inside randomNumber.
number feeds the weak randomness seed inside randomNumber.
bHash feeds the weak randomness seed inside randomNumber.
random is a transient intermediate inside randomNumber.
result is the returned value of randomNumber.
partner is consumed by processReferralSystem invoked from buyTicket.
playerNumber captures the player index emitted by buyTicket.
winner index is only meaningful inside pickTheWinner.
toPlayer is the payout amount computed in pickTheWinner.
distribute is the commission computed in pickTheWinner.
partner is only used by processReferralSystem.
referral is only used by processReferralSystem.
partnerRef is a transient resolution inside processReferralSystem.
referral is queried against the referral instance inside transferToPartner.
partner is the resolved payout target inside transferToPartner.
sum is the amount transferred by transferToPartner.
partner is the input of transferToSalesPartner.
salesPartner is the resolved payout target of transferToSalesPartner.
sum is the amount transferred by transferToSalesPartner.
partner is the lookup key of getPartnerAmount.
partnerPercent drives the payout returned by getPartnerAmount.
partner is the lookup key of getSalesPartnerAmount.
salesPartnerPercent drives the payout returned by getSalesPartnerAmount.
